name: Aims Max Gardenia Golf City
description: Aims Max Gardenia Golf City is a massive ready-to-move 80-acre thematic township in Sector 75, Noida, featuring rich sports amenities and close metro connectivity.
long_description: Aims Max Gardenia Golf City is a landmark ready-to-move-in residential township spread over a sprawling 80 acres in Central Noida, Sector 75. Developed by Aims Max Gardenia Developers Pvt. Ltd., the project houses over 900 apartments across 25 magnificent towers. Designed with a distinct 'golf-centric' lifestyle, nearly 80% of the project's layout is dedicated to beautifully manicured green expanses, water bodies, and outdoor activity courts. Residents enjoy premium facilities including an Olympic-length adult swimming pool, a separate toddler pool with slides, a grand central clubhouse with a restaurant, and a highly active sports complex featuring lawn tennis and basketball zones. The project's location is a massive highlight, sitting just 500 meters from the Sector 50 Aqua Line Metro Station and directly across the newly opened Medanta Super-Speciality Hospital. However, buyers should note that registries are currently frozen due to ₹1,717 Crore in legacy land dues owed by the builder SPC to the Noida Authority.
tagline: Golf-Centric Urban Serenity

why_buy: High-Acreage Greenery: Spread over 80 acres with lush, golf-centric landscaped gardens and parks.
Metro Proximity: Less than 500m walk to the Sector 50 Aqua Line Metro Station.
Extremely Affordable Entry: Resale price per sqft is nearly half of neighboring premium projects.
Immediately Occupied: Fully ready and buzzing with over 900 residential units.
why_avoid: Colossal Builder Dues: Developer SPC owes over ₹1,717 Crore in outstanding land lease dues to Noida Authority.

Maintenance Gaps: Common spaces, lifts, and fire fighting systems suffer from developer fund diversion.
